description: See how people voted on a WhichDateWorks poll and which option is winning. Pass the poll's id or its invite link to see what the public poll page shows: if the organizer hid scores or participant names, they stay hidden. Pass its manageUrl instead to get the organizer's view, with every name and count. Don't share hidden names with people other than the organizer.

inviteUrl.description: The poll's invite link, if you don't have its id.

manageUrl.description: The poll's manageUrl, if that's the link you have. Gives the organizer's view: every name and count, even ones hidden from guests.

name: get_poll_results

start.description: Time slot start, in the poll's time zone with its offset.

weekday.description: Day of the week the option falls on, in the poll's time zone, like "Friday". Check it against what the user asked for.

participantsHidden.description: The organizer hid who voted from guests. In the public view names are left out; the organizer view still has them.

scoresHidden.description: The organizer hid the scores from guests. In the public view vote counts are left out; the organizer view still has them.

view.description: Whose view this is. "organizer" (from a manageUrl) includes names and counts the poll hides from guests: don't share hidden names with anyone but the organizer.

title: Get poll results
